findings: All 36 HTTP requests returned 200 without authentication or rate errors.
The exact PumpAPI-reported migrated pool was absent at 0, 5, 15 and 30 seconds for all three samples.
The exact migrated pool appeared by the 60-second probe for all three samples and remained visible at 120 seconds.
Token lookup may already return a pre-migration/bonding-curve pair, so token-lookup presence does not prove the migrated pool has indexed.
Token pair counts can increase over time as additional pools index.
The sample supports optional delayed market enrichment, not a universal 60-second guarantee or canonical migration truth.
